notes: Read all 51 numbered source lines before editing. This module is pure, non-visual timezone-resolution logic plus one thin React hook. The three pure exports (TzMode, browserTimezone, resolveTimezone) rely only on the ECMAScript Intl.DateTimeFormat API + plain string comparison, both available identically under Hermes (React Native) and Node (Jest); no DOM, no Recharts/Leaflet/react-leaflet, no old web-UI import, no unit-suffixed (Mi/Mph/Kwh) field, and no i18n strings. The native useDateFormat port already inlines private copies of these three helpers — this file is their canonical public home.

L1-2 imports adapted (the only structural change): web `@/hooks/useSettings` (app-level wrapper) -> native `../api/hooks/useSettings` (the same ['settings'] TanStack query) and web `@/hooks/useSelectedVehicle` -> native `../api/hooks/useVehicles`, because the native web-parity layer has no global selected-vehicle context. L10-17 browserTimezone ported with identical behavior: `Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone || 'UTC'` inside try/catch returning 'UTC' on failure. The exported name is preserved verbatim; only the JSDoc was widened from 'browser' to 'host runtime (device under React Native, browser under react-native-web)' to be accurate on native — behavior is unchanged.

L19-28 resolveTimezone JSDoc preserved (the utc/user/vehicle bullet contract; 'browser tz' phrased as 'host tz'). L29-39 resolveTimezone body ported logically identical: utc -> 'UTC'; userTz = (userOverride && userOverride.trim()) ? userOverride : browserTimezone(); user -> userTz; (!vehicleTz || vehicleTz === 'UTC') -> userTz; else vehicleTz. The three single-line `if (...) return ...;` statements were wrapped in braces to satisfy the native eslint `curly` rule (same treatment as the bucketing.ts / i18nDir.ts ports) — byte-for-byte equivalent.

L41-46 useTimezone JSDoc preserved, with the data-source sentence updated to reflect the native substitution (vehicle tz from the fleet's first vehicle via useVehicles, user override via useSettings). L47-51 useTimezone body ported preserving the exact `mode: TzMode = 'vehicle'` default and `string` return type: web `const { vehicle } = useSelectedVehicle()` -> native `const { data: vehicles } = useVehicles()` + `vehicleTz = vehicles && vehicles.length > 0 ? vehicles[0].timezone : undefined`; web `const { settings } = useSettings()` -> native `const { data: settings } = useSettings()`; final call is `resolveTimezone(mode, vehicleTz, settings?.timezone_user)`. resolveTimezone already treats nullish/empty override as 'no override', so the unresolved-settings path matches the web wrapper's `timezone_user: ''` default behavior (falls back to host zone).

Native Vehicle type (../api/hooks/useVehicles) exposes `timezone?: string`, and AppSettings (../api/hooks/useSettings) exposes `timezone_user?: string`, so both reads typecheck without casts.
